verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management platform. Its agents act on boards, items and updates, not on source repositories, so signing AI-authored git commits is outside its product category. The GitHub/GitLab integration only links pull requests to items; it does not author or sign commits, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
